review_kind: independent read-only source, raw-counter, archive, report and provenance review
live_input_check_scope: All 230 protected source/proof/frozen/C/object/binary inputs matched at review time, before diagnostic hold release. No assertion about later authorized optimization changes.
independent_methods: The raw Callgrind parser is separate from production tooling. It sums only self records, independently totals call-entry and inclusive-edge records, and derives exclusive stages from full caller-name chains instead of the production graph-propagation algorithm.

All 13 primary raw gzip profiles were checked against run logs, campaign digests and analysis hashes; all 2,756 per-stage symbol rows were independently reconstructed, including all 15 displayed hottest Comm-B helpers.
The source review binds 22 committed Lean source and freshly timed generated-C/object/trace sets, plus 21 reused diagnostic objects and the actual retained worker/driver binaries.

All 435 primary archive members matched stored and decoded hashes/sizes. All 1,484 historical committed report/evidence/benchmark files matched exact bytes and membership; all three older external raw perf files matched their recorded hashes and sizes.

All 48 generation-3 benchmark artifacts remain byte-identical to the ignored original run and their archive manifest. Report family/stage/comparison/allocation/helper tables were checked against recounted values.

Perf raw data hash and 573 sample records were checked; 393 exact-root visible stacks and 569 samples containing an unknown frame reproduce the reported sampling limits. Capture preceded all native diagnostic runs.

The synthetic stage-crossing fixture independently confirms that an ancestor inclusive count can include later-stage work while exclusive self totals remain exact. Source review also verifies the recursion fixture and explicit reporting caveats.
limits: Instruction counts and native allocation counts are diagnostics, not elapsed time, cycles, byte allocations or predicted throughput.
Summed incoming inclusive edges overlap between symbols, within recursive symbol groups and across later stage boundaries. Only self totals form the exact partition.
Perf attribution is conditional on visible ancestry and is not an unbiased whole-decoder timing split. The review does not infer host isolation.
No build, native decoder run, benchmark, runtime/proof change or frozen-file change was performed by this review; the only executed fixture is a tiny synthetic Python parser fixture.
hold_release_recommendation: Independent gen3 diagnostic review complete; no remaining review blocker to parent-controlled hold release.
